# FLX-3105: bundle does not validate, so its seam cannot be resolved

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Resolution delegates to the FLUX offline reference validator: every reference resolves, every id is unique, every weight sums, and every in-bundle FLUID document is valid for its declared version. A bundle that fails those checks has no seam to resolve, and repairing it here would mean the engine ran against something the validator refused.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3105
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
